description: Susceptibilidad Hundimientos debido a Disolución is a dataset listed in IDEE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by mapas-gis-inter.carm.es. The Protected Soils against Natural Risks according to the Guidelines and Territorial Planning Plan of the Mula, Vega Alta and Oriental River are shown because they are located on areas susceptible to sinking due to dissolution. Coverage: ES. The portal shows the English title as "Susceptibility Sinking due to Dissolution" (machine-translated by the portal). The listing shows 3 download or service links in WFS, WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-idee.
